name: The Berkeley
positioning: Design-led Knightsbridge hotel between Belgravia and Hyde Park, with a rooftop pool and a four-floor wellbeing club
best_for: Travelers who want a Knightsbridge base near Hyde Park
Guests who want designer suites with terraces
Wellness-minded guests who want spa, gym and pool access in central London

facts.text: The Berkeley sits between Belgravia, Knightsbridge and Hyde Park.
The hotel's address is Wilton Place, Knightsbridge, London.
Green Park and Hyde Park neighbour the hotel.
Each of the hotel's suites and rooms is the work of an acclaimed designer.
Rooms have a contemporary East-meets-West aesthetic and generous Italian marble bathrooms.
The Opus Suite is a two-bedroom suite designed by André Fu.
The Hyde Park Penthouse has a firepit and panoramic park views.
The Berkeley has two pools, including a light-filled pool with underwater meditation soundscapes.
Surrenne Belgravia has wellness spaces, treatment rooms and a gym.
The spa offers Tracy Anderson classes and bespoke facials, and the hotel also has a medical-grade hyperbaric oxygen chamber.
La Môme London brings the glamour of the French Riviera to the hotel.
The Snug in the downstairs bar can be booked for private gatherings and has a mural by New York artist TM Davy.

highlights.text: Every stay includes access to Surrenne Belgravia, the hotel's wellbeing and longevity club spanning four floors of health, fitness and beauty.
The Berkeley's rooftop pool was London's first rooftop pool.
Suites open onto sweeping terraces with city views.
The Berkeley is a heritage hotel made modern through design collaborations.
Pastry chef Cedric Grolet is the hotel's pâtissier-in-residence.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
WhataHotel notes the busy Knightsbridge location may have high foot traffic.
